claim_boundary: Study H is an imported historical panel. Results are conditional on observed checkpoints, inferred families, resampling, and null protocols.

ADD_ABILITY_SUBJECT.estimated: additive logit model and subject effects
ADD_ABILITY_SUBJECT.fixed: observed model and subject aggregate rates plus subject sample sizes
ADD_ABILITY_SUBJECT.hypothesis: no model-by-subject interaction beyond additive ability and difficulty

DETERMINISTIC_MODEL_SUBJECT_PERTURBATION.fixed: deterministic perturbation grid scaled by observed residual spread
DETERMINISTIC_MODEL_SUBJECT_PERTURBATION.hypothesis: structured perturbation sensitivity; not a random-effects model

FAMILY_CORRELATED_NULL.estimated: additive rates and family mean residuals
FAMILY_CORRELATED_NULL.hypothesis: family-correlated deviations explain observed subject dispersion
FAMILY_CORRELATED_NULL.randomized: binomial counts from additive plus family residual probabilities

FIXED_PRIOR_SHRUNK_ADDITIVE.estimated: model rates and fixed-prior shrunk subject rates
FIXED_PRIOR_SHRUNK_ADDITIVE.fixed: prior strength 20 and observed subject sample sizes
FIXED_PRIOR_SHRUNK_ADDITIVE.hypothesis: additive effects after prespecified shrinkage; not empirical Bayes

MODEL_TOTAL_SUBJECT_SIZE_HYPERGEOMETRIC.fixed: each model total successes and subject item counts
MODEL_TOTAL_SUBJECT_SIZE_HYPERGEOMETRIC.hypothesis: responses are exchangeable across subjects within model
MODEL_TOTAL_SUBJECT_SIZE_HYPERGEOMETRIC.randomized: allocation of model successes across subject-size blocks

SUBJECT_SIZE_ONLY.fixed: model aggregate rates and subject sample sizes
